evaluation.phase_convention: positive lag means estimate lags applied reference; no time shift in RMSE

implementation_choices.controller: Existing design.json PD gains and fixed q_hold_rad, without gravity feedforward or external-force truth
implementation_choices.measurement: Noise-free q/v and actual qfrc_actuator; torque proxy, not measured current
implementation_choices.nominal: Independent MuJoCo model with deliberately matching parameters for the prerequisite only
implementation_choices.force_state: World-axis wrench about tool0, random walk; not assumed constant joint torque
implementation_choices.covariance: Borrowed local-document illustrative values; not original paper parameters or a calibrated sensor model
implementation_choices.gates: Numerical and safety gates only; no fitted performance acceptance threshold
implementation_choices.scope: Known-dynamics prerequisite; no learned dynamics, backlash compensation, or WMA
